tei:div.tei:p: )gsang sngags snga 'gyur bka' gter bla ma brgyud pa'i phreng ba la gsol 'debs dngos grub gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so// thog ma'i mgon po chos sku kun tu bzang*// rig mdangs longs sku rigs lnga rdo rje 'chang*// rdor sems mchog gi ston pa bcu gnyis sogs// dgongs brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// snang ba mtha' yas rta phag rigs gsum mgon// dga' rab rdo rje shrī sengha dang*// dbang gi rgyal mo rig 'dzin rnam pa brgyad// brda brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos pad+ma 'byung*// rgyal yum mtsho rgyal thugs sras a tsar+ya// chos rgyal khu dbon rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs// snyan brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rdo rje chos dang ku ku rgyal po dzaḥ rgya bod mkhas grub rnams dang so zur gnubs// gsang bdag sgro phug g.yung ston chen po sogs// bka' brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// mnga' bdag nyang ral chos kyi dbang phyug dang*// 'khrul med gling pa bcu gcig dri med gsum// rgod kyi ldem 'phru pad+ma dbang rgyal sogs// gter brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// ting 'dzin bzang po ldang ma lhun gyi rgyal// lce btsun yab sras nyang ston sku mched dang*// me long ku ma ra dang rang byung sogs// snying thig brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// ma lus brgyud pa'i chu bo kun 'dus shing*// smin dang grol ba'i gdams pa ji snyed pa// rgyal thabs spyi blug tshul du stsol mdzad pa// nus ldan rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// ji snyed shes bya rgya mtsho'i pha rol son// ji lta'i rang byung bden don chos nyid gzigs// zab gsang 'khor lo'i gtso bo rigs kun bdag /chos rje gling pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ ༈ /rgyal kun ngo bo mtsho skyes pad 'byung gi /thugs rje'i bden stobs rgyal ba byang chub 'phrul// gsang chen dgongs 'dus smin grol bdud rtsi'i char// 'bebs mdzad bsam gtan bstan 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs// rigs kun khyab bdag dpal ldan bla ma yi// byin rlabs mchog thob gnas lugs rang zhal gzigs// 'phrul snang bden med zhig pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rig 'dzin dbang rgyal zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// kun tu dge legs rgya mtsho'i dpal bzang po// nam bzhag gtan bde'i mkha' dbyings rdo rje yi// rgyal mchog rigs lnga'i byin rlabs 'pho ba yi// kun bzang nam mkha' rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// rigs kun khyab bdag pad 'byung bsam gtan gling*// gang gi sgyu 'phrul rjes chags bstan 'gro'i dpal// chos don gnad gsum gong ma'i lam bgrod pa'i// kun bzang pad+ma rnam rgyal la gsol ba 'debs// o rgyan chen po'i zab gter gdams pa'i mdzod// rta mchog dgongs 'dus chos kyi snyan grags rngas// sa gsum 'geng mdzad rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rig 'dzin 'khor lo'i mgon de'i phrin las 1$0000027kyi// zlos gar gsang chen 'dus pa zab mo'i mdzod// smin grol bdud rtsi 'jo ba'i bum pa bzang*// pad+ma lhun grub dbang rgyal la gsol ba 'debs// dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las sgyu 'phrul gar// rdo rje slob dpon mchog gi skur ston pa// bka' drin mnyam med khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon// bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal bstan nor 'dzin yangs pa'i skyed tshal du// skal bzang 'dus pa 'dab stong bye ba'i mgon// grub rigs nyi gzhon gsar pa'i gnyen gyur pa// skyabs mgon me tog rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs// pad+ma bde byed rol pa'i mkha' dbyings nas// dbang chen dgongs 'dus nor bu'i 'od stong brdal// smon lam rlung gi 'khor lo'i zhing du drangs// seng ha gu ru'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dag mnyam gzhi yi gnas lugs ji bzhin rtogs// bskyed rdzogs lam gyi rnal 'byor mtha' ru phyin// zung 'jug 'bras bu mngon gyur tshe la dbang*// mchog tu grub pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bskal mang tshogs gnyis bskrun pa'i legs byas kyis// byang chub sems mchog gzugs sku'i rol gar las// gzhan phan mkha' dang mnyam pa'i phrin las can// mtshungs med bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs// 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// rang sems chos sku mngon sum ston mdzad pa// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// chos sku snang mtha' longs sku spyan ras gzigs// sprul sku pad 'byung mtsho rgyal sa le 'od// rgyal sras lha rje rig 'dzin yab sras bcas// don brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// skye ba kun tu gsang chen rdo rje yi// theg dgu'i gzhung lam chen por rab zhugs nas// bshad sgrub thos bsam sgom dang phrin las bzhis// rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par shog

/1$0000022dgongs brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul// ces tshig 'og ma kun la tshig phrad bsgyur kha rig pa'i shes/ 'khor lo'i mgon po dharmā swa mis mdzad pa'o/// /
